What we want from you

  • Try the killer demo: tap the mic, say "medium fry from McDonald's". Did it work?
  • Log 3+ meals from your real day. Where did the macros feel off?
  • Snap a photo of something layered. Did the follow-up question feel useful?
  • If anything weird happens, hit Send Beta Feedback with a screenshot.
